quote.text: Everything is vague to a degree you do not realize till you have tried to make it precise.
quote.author: Bertrand Russell, The Philosophy of Logical Atomism, Lecture I (1918) — for an issue in which most of the arguing is about which number is the real one

stories.kicker: The Little Red Dot · two bills, one barrel
stories.headline: Two household bills moved on Tuesday, in opposite directions. The same barrel of oil set both
stories.dek: Electricity falls 10.4 per cent today, for one quarter. Fares rise 7.0 per cent in December, for good. The difference is not the fuel but which months each formula may look at.

stories.kicker: Buy It Once · EDC torches & headlamps
stories.headline: The four-thousand-lumen claim is a thirty-second claim. Ask for the candela instead
stories.dek: A category where the sixteen-dollar light renders colour better than the two-hundred-and-sixty-five-dollar one, and the premium tier’s best-known name cannot legally say where it is made.

stories.headline: The regulator tried to stop the middle class free-riding. It made a battery worth four times a grid connection
stories.dek: Islamabad cut what it pays households for their surplus solar to about eleven rupees a unit. The unit they keep is worth forty to fifty-five. The customers did not comply. They left.

stories.headline: Moscow put the nuclear threat in writing. The man it was sent to says he does not take it seriously
stories.dek: One news agency has seen the document and nobody else has. The blockade it promises to answer with nuclear weapons appears in no published NATO plan.

stories.headline: Micron sold its 2027 supply before it built it, and Singapore is packaging the part
stories.dek: Thirty-two billion dollars of customer commitments, most of it cash deposits, on contracts running to 2031. The company says it cannot see when supply and demand return to balance.

stories.headline: Ninety-one per cent faster on a twelve-gigabyte card, and vetoed the same day
stories.dek: A maintainer closed it inside one working day on design grounds. A tester with three cards then found the acceptance rate collapsing — which makes the veto look like judgement rather than gatekeeping.

stories.kicker: Gear We’re Watching · the shelf-sized lab
stories.headline: A hundred and sixty gigabytes of video memory, in a box you can put on a shelf
stories.dek: Two vendors put the same chip on sale a day apart. Nobody has independently measured either — and the honest proxy, on last year’s silicon, suggests you are buying capacity rather than speed.

stories.headline: Two prices, one watch: the Monterey’s nineteen and twenty-three thousand euros are the same number
stories.dek: No. 118 could not reconcile them. The gap is twenty-one per cent, which is Dutch value-added tax. What the desk should have questioned instead is the movement.

stories.headline: America’s number one was seven years old. Japan’s was a cartoon cat, and it is eight times bigger
stories.dek: A re-release with new footage took the US weekend from three genuinely new wide openings. In Tokyo the nostalgia story everyone is writing about is the smaller one.

stories.headline: A paper published last week finds the hours do not predict the harm. What she discloses does
stories.dek: Time on social media fell out of the model as non-significant. The variable that survived is a three-item scale nobody has validated — and the average child in the study is fifteen.

stories.kicker: The Big Picture · the long end
stories.headline: The Fed got a dovish surprise on Wednesday. The thirty-year sold off anyway
stories.dek: Core inflation undershot on both horizons and thirty points of October hike risk came out in a session. Duration fell anyway — the long end has stopped trading the policy rate.

stories.kicker: Down the Rabbit Hole · freediving & spearfishing
stories.headline: The technique runs out at the same depth the physics does. That wall is where the hobby begins
stories.dek: Around thirty metres the lungs reach residual volume and the ordinary way of clearing your ears stops working. Everything enthusiasts spend money on is an answer to those two facts arriving together.

stories.headline: The curve bends hard in the first hundred and fifty minutes, then very nearly stops
stories.dek: A meta-analysis published yesterday puts the plateau near thirty MET-hours a week. Everything the optimiser buys past that, he is buying for some reason other than mortality.

stories.headline: Two Saturdays, two stadiums, and the one date to set a reminder for is in December
stories.dek: Every row below was re-checked against a venue, promoter or official seller. Several candidates failed that test and were dropped; they are named at the foot.
